hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) uvx ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) out=$(uvx ruff check --select F401 --quiet "$f" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$out" ] && { printf 'Unused import(s) — add the usage now, or they will be removed at task end:\n%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && { printf '%s' "$f" > ~/.claude/last-edit; printf '%s\n' "$f" >> ~/.claude/pending-format; }; } 2>/dev/null || true

f=~/.claude/pending-format; [ -s "$f" ] && { sort -u "$f" | while IFS= read -r p; do case "$p" in *.py) [ -f "$p" ] && { uvx ruff check --fix "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; uvx ruff format "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; };; esac; done; : > "$f"; }; true
